dct_description_sm: Moose are an important traditional and cultural resource for northern communities, and an important traditional food species.  This project was conducted to determine baseline levels of metals in kidneys of harvested moose in the Mackenzie valley, southern Mackenzie Mountains and South Slave Region of the Northwest Territories.   It also followed up on some previous work showing differences in renal cadmium levels in moose from the southern Mackenzie mountains compared to moose harvested in the Mackenzie valley.
dct_subject_sm: Health sciences and contaminants -> Heavy metal
dct_title_s: Cadmium and select metals in Northwest Territories moose
